verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no account-wide export of Spaces, Cua Volume contents, agent memory or audit logs in open formats. Several nearby items exist but are adjacent rather than this capability: one-command removal of Cua that leaves Spaces data in place (cua-docs-29), running Spaces on your own machines (cua-docs-20), use of any OCI image as an input, and Cua-Bench trajectory export, which is a separate feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
